guitar.evidence: Kevin "Noodles" Wasserman is well documented for playing Ibanez guitars, including his own Ibanez signature model.

tone.target: tight bright punk rock crunch with scooped mids
tone.profile: tight bright punk rock crunch with scooped mids
tone.summary: A high-gain, punchy punk rock chain using a British amp model (UK 45) with an aggressive overdrive boost and bright cab simulation for maximum tightness and bite.

rig.name: The Offspring - The Kids Aren't Alright - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up aggressive palm-muting and pick noise.
Provide aggressive pick attack and tighten the low end without excessive gain.
blocks.gap: Using Boost for controlled aggression, as OD/Green OD might muddy the tight punk sound.

blocks.purpose: Add aggressive punk crunch and grit while maintaining clarity for fast riffs.
blocks.gap: RAT-style provides the necessary bite and mid-range punch characteristic of early 2000s pop-punk.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall JCM-style punch and aggressive British tone.
Provide the classic British punk rock cabinet sound and necessary punch.
Achieve the required 'scooped mids' while boosting upper frequencies for brightness and bite.
blocks.gap: The EQ is used to sculpt the tone post-amp/cab, focusing on mid-range scoop and high-end clarity.

blocks.purpose: Optional wah for rhythmic accents (kept off by default to maintain raw punk sound).
blocks.gap: The verdict explicitly suggests 'drop wah', so it is included but deactivated.

blocks.purpose: Keep the sound dry and raw as requested; delay is bypassed.
blocks.gap: The verdict emphasizes 'lean more dry and raw', so this module is included but kept inactive/minimal.

blocks.purpose: Minimal ambience to keep the sound focused and raw.
blocks.gap: Used only for subtle space; kept low to avoid 'clean wash'.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better punch and definition in fast punk riffs.

proposals.reason: Enhance low-end tightness and punch for aggressive palm-muting.
